{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
trial_df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Check for missing values
missing_values = trial_df.isnull().sum()

# Check for duplicates
duplicates = trial_df.duplicated().sum()

# Check the distribution of the 'arm' column
arm_distribution = trial_df['arm'].value_counts()

# Check the distribution of the 'responded' column
response_distribution = trial_df['responded'].value_counts()

# Check for sentinel values in biomarker_baseline
sentinel_values = trial_df[trial_df['biomarker_baseline'] == -999.0]

# Print results
missing_values, duplicates, arm_distribution, response_distribution, len(sentinel_values)"}
